stable_owns: which exact result depends on which result
which writers conflict or may proceed in parallel
never_owns: current main SHA or implementation state
what a coding agent may start today

role_vocabulary.owns: programme, umbrella, or closure authority; never assignable to ordinary implementation and never a direct dependency of a leaf
one assignable one-PR repository proposition that adds or replaces an authority with an exact exit
adds exact evidence, receipts, or inventory over an existing authority; cannot repair what it observes
moves one live authority and retires or bounds the exact old route in the same change
a settled or open architecture decision recorded as a node; never coding work
repository creation, history import, tag/release, registry mutation, or other action requiring explicit authorization
landed, superseded, transferred, or duplicate subject kept as architecture input; never selectable

dependency_classes.meaning: the node cannot establish its proposition until the predecessor result is current on main
implementation may land while the later host, platform, or content evidence row remains NOT_PROVEN; evidence never manufactures implementation readiness
an explicit external authority must grant the action; internal readiness, labels, green checks, or tool availability never satisfy it

release_horizons.meaning: root, path, opened-byte, and control-plane safety that every later result consumes
typed registration of every asset, producer, and structural relationship population
generic expectations, gold envelopes/extensions, generator profiles, HIR stability
one CorpusWorkspace, vocabularies, backfill, and command contract
typed audit plan, receipts, supervision, evidence, and current-input report
consumer inventory/migration/recurrence, docs reconciliation, required CI routes
package isolation, extraction manifest, external repository proof, consumer cutover, embedded removal
repository creation/history import, tag/release, registry publication under explicit authorization
parser-accuracy strata, highlight execution, and community journeys that never block earlier horizons

limitations: this manifest encodes stable topology only; it does not prove that any node is implemented, ready, or landed on the current tree (#10992 owns that)
controllers and umbrellas carry no dependency edges by design; a leaf never depends on a controller, and a controller's closure is derived from its leaves' propositions
dependencies on umbrella issues in leaf headers (#6980, #6985, #6989, #6716, #7009) are routed to the leaf that owns the result and recorded in the edge provenance
cross-programme prerequisites (#6261, #7745, #8056, #8081) are declared external authorities; their current-tree state is not establishable from this data
candidate lineages record reuse policy only; live candidate state belongs to #11001

generic mechanics duplicated pending the #10554 gate: title fingerprint law, banned-key walk, hard-cycle search; the canonical digest and canonical form are consumed from the module_train and native_neovim_train modules

revision_governance.invalidates: a classified semantic revision of node set, roles, dependency classes, conflict keys, horizons, authority transitions, or exits must regenerate the projections through cargo xtask perl-corpus-train graph and re-run check; stale projections fail closed
revision_governance.never: issue closure, merged pull requests, labels, green checks, or agent activity never amend a stable node fact; the manifest never rewrites itself to pass
revision_governance.metadata_only: wording that changes no node identity, role, edge, class, key, horizon, authority, or exit is metadata-only and invalidates no derived state beyond regenerating projections
